summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Bread Financial Holdings, Inc. reporting its Q1 2026 earnings results and declaring regular quarterly dividends on its common and preferred stock. There is no transactional special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing consists entirely of ordinary operational updates and standard dividend declarations.
